theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpo_slice_end_form
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) k), ∃ ρ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, ∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (ρ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))
